rpm_requests.interpretation: Each Data Plane received a two-request local allowance, consistent with rpm_limit 6 divided by 3 process nodes; requests admitted by the fallback limiter then failed closed for the intentionally absent route. No upstream provider traffic occurred.

classifications.postgresql_revocation_fallback: PASS (scoped: both Data Planes immediately rejected replay)
classifications.valkey_recovery: PASS (cluster converged to 16384/16384 healthy slots and all application readiness probes returned 200)

visual_inspection: The Virtual Key form, in-outage revoked-key inventory, eight metadata-only trace outcomes, in-outage Operations state and recovered cluster Operations view were visually inspected. The final inventory showing all 10 campaign keys as Revoked was also visually inspected.
limitations: Three-primary Valkey test cluster had no replicas; primary failover/promotion was not exercised.
No concurrent rate-limit boundary races, budget reservation margins, 2-second notification latency bound, emergency revocation, active stream, or second-tenant cases.
A simultaneous PostgreSQL+Valkey partition longer than 10 seconds and readiness fail-closed behavior remain unverified.
An earlier isolated single-node Valkey interruption (cluster_state=fail, PostgreSQL healthy) is not treated as a complete Valkey outage or defect.
